title: Rongmei language and alphabet
text: Rongmei is a member of the Kuki-Chin-Naga branch of the Sino-Tibetan language family. It is spoken mainly in the states of Assam, Manipur and Nagaland in the northeast of India by about 350,000 Rongmei Naga people.
